facts.text: Pass the Oreos and peanut butter. Dad won't notice the swap while we eat.
facts.why: Printed as Hallie's words, but she never says it. In the isolation bunk Hallie offers Oreos, Annie says she eats them with peanut butter, and Hallie pulls out a jar and says 'So do I!'.
facts.fix: That is so weird... So do I!

fix_note.text: That is so weird... So do I!

facts.text: Crustless white bread with butter, cucumber and dill, the London butler's tea tray
facts.why: Martin is the James family butler, but TV Tropes, Wikipedia and the transcript show no tea tray or cucumber sandwiches in the film.
facts.fix: Crustless white bread with butter, cucumber and dill, in honour of Martin the family butler
